nodes.name: Code - Binary to Data URI
nodes.notes: If your n8n version exposes binary differently, adjust this node. It must output json.imageDataUri as a data:image/...;base64,... string.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_OPENROUTER_MODEL', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: [ { type: 'text', text: 'Identify the board game shown in this photo of a box or component. Respond with strict JSON only, no markdown fences, no extra text: {"title": "best guess title here"}' }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: $json.imageDataUri } } ] } ] }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP - OpenRouter Vision
nodes.notes: Attach your OpenRouter HTTP Header Auth credential (Header Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer <your key>). Set the model to a vision-capable OpenRouter model id you have access to, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5 or openai/gpt-4o.

nodes.name: Code - Parse Search XML
nodes.notes: Raw XML string is expected on items[0].json.data (httpRequest 'Response Format: Text'). If your HTTP Request node is set to parse XML automatically instead, adjust accordingly.
